loc_platform_zero.name: Platform Zero & Phantom Subway Track
loc_platform_zero.base_horror_sensory: The tunnel air tastes of decades-old brake dust and wet copper. Wristwatches stutter backward between heartbeats, and behind blackened carriage glass stand dozens of commuter silhouettes whose faces have been smoothed into seamless ceramic ovals turned toward the platform.
loc_platform_zero.gore_horror_sensory: Where passengers pressed against the doors before impact, palms and teeth have fused half-way into the rusted steel plating—still trembling softly whenever the phantom horn drones from the dark bore ahead.
loc_platform_zero.pacified_sensory: The station settles into mournful subterranean quiet; the split-flap board hangs motionless without slipping time, and the faceless silhouettes sit with folded hands like harmless alabaster memorials.
loc_platform_zero.crowd_stillness_prose: Beyond the chain-link cordon, only the stagnant draught of unscheduled trains and a metallic tick of desynchronized clocks stir the dust.

domain_rule.name: Timeless Schedule Drift
domain_rule.hazard_cue: A phantom departure chime echoes down the tunnel, skipping minutes off everyone's sense of time while sub-audible static gnaws at arcane focus.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Phase-lagged rail acoustics sharpen spatial awareness and amplify temporal aether resonance.

variants.backlash_prose: Dozens of fused clasps snap shut on phantom fingers, jolting your nerves.

variants.backlash_prose: The carriage doors slam in succession down the train, bruising your shoulder in a pressure wave.

variants.clue_text: Hundreds of stopped wristwatches hang fused like a wasp nest above the faceless passengers.
variants.success_prose: You shatter the central brass movement, dispersing the frozen rush-hour echo.
variants.backlash_prose: Every smooth faceless head turns toward you at once as static slams into your skull.

variants.backlash_prose: An unnatural cold gushes out of the destination box, misting your breath white.

boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: The final phantom brake-valve hisses shut; the station clock settles on a quiet mundane hour.

loc_inverted_skybridge.name: The Inverted Skybridge Anomaly
loc_inverted_skybridge.base_horror_sensory: Forty stories up, gravity leans sideways at forty-five degrees. Rain splatters uphill against cracked skylight panels, the floor glass groans under phantom footsteps walking overhead, and one misstep toward a missing pane promises a terminal plummet through razor-edged drafts.
loc_inverted_skybridge.gore_horror_sensory: At the far beam, dark radial streaks smear upward along the ceiling tiles where a maintenance crew fell *into* the roof glass; shreds of yellow slicker still snap like kites in the glass teeth.
loc_inverted_skybridge.pacified_sensory: Gravity settles straight beneath your boots with only a faint, buoyant lightness left in the floorboards; wind chimes along the structural girders instead of howling.
loc_inverted_skybridge.crowd_stillness_prose: Behind the bolted 40th-floor airlock, only the whine of up-draft wind through cracked glass fills the empty corridor.

domain_rule.ambient_summary: Thin high-altitude air currents lighten footing and heighten wind manipulation.

loc_hosp_floor_13.name: Quarantined Floor 13 Bio-Occult Ward Anomaly
loc_hosp_floor_13.base_horror_sensory: The decommissioned elevator opens into wet furnace heat thick with formalin and sweet rot. Black mold veins throb like capillaries beneath peeling mint paint, IV bags bloat with dark clotted sediment, and muffled wet coughing rises from empty isolation beds.
loc_hosp_floor_13.gore_horror_sensory: Behind the cracked lead-glass window, discarded hospital gowns ripple over ribs and fused vertebrae grown directly into the plasterboard—shed skins that still draw shallow, bubbling breaths.
loc_hosp_floor_13.pacified_sensory: The fever-heat recedes to cold sterile air; the black veins along the plaster calcify into brittle ash, though Floor 13 never loses the sharp antiseptic chill.
loc_hosp_floor_13.crowd_stillness_prose: Plastic isolation sheeting hangs stiff with dried iodine behind hazard tape; no orderly dares ride an elevator past Floor 12.

loc_hosp_theater_zero.gore_horror_sensory: Black arterial stains soak outward beneath the hydraulic pedestal as disembodied scalpels click together overhead, rehearsing meticulous incisions across an unseen patient's chest cavity.
loc_hosp_theater_zero.pacified_sensory: The red scrub lamp dims to dead glass and the surgical instruments lie heavy and mute, though every metal edge in the room retains an uncanny mirror-keen edge.
loc_hosp_theater_zero.crowd_stillness_prose: Behind bolted basement doors, no nurses walk this wing—only the dry click of cooling steam pipes and steel.

loc_endless_dept_store.gore_horror_sensory: Closer inspection reveals several mannequins aren't fiberglass: fingernails poke through painted plaster knuckles, and damp hair sprouts through cracked skulls beneath stiff bridal veils.
loc_endless_dept_store.pacified_sensory: Fluorescent buzz drops to normal mall silence; exits lead reliably back to Downtown sidewalks without bending hallways around you.
loc_endless_dept_store.crowd_stillness_prose: Police tape crosses the frosted doors; the department store hasn't turned off an aisle bulb since containment began.

loc_whispering_paleontology.name: The Whispering Paleontology Wing Anomaly
loc_whispering_paleontology.base_horror_sensory: Dry museum silence rings so tightly it hurts the eardrums—then you notice the mounted fossils aren't silent. Hollow limestone skulls harmonize in dry, papery clicks whenever you think of a word, throwing off concentration as shadows stretch longer than the skeletons.
loc_whispering_paleontology.gore_horror_sensory: Fingernail-length splinters along the marble plaques show where frantic researchers tried digging out fused marrow-plates that had begun growing across their own forearms and collarbones.
loc_whispering_paleontology.pacified_sensory: The clicking chorus subsides to cold limestone stillness; fossils stand inertly behind brass rails, lending ancient stillness to anyone studying the hall.
loc_whispering_paleontology.crowd_stillness_prose: Dust motes hang motionless behind plastic bio-curtains; museum docents lock every connecting corridor leading toward Paleontology.

domain_rule.hazard_cue: Dry sub-audible clicks chime out of hollow skulls, scrambling higher reasoning and vocal poise.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Prehistoric mineral acoustics sharpen memory recall and geomagnetic earth grounding.

variants.label: Crush the Whispering Audio Headsets
variants.clue_text: Stacked tour headsets murmur extinct names through unplugged receivers.
variants.success_prose: You smash the rack charger, cutting the chorus's lobby amplifier.
variants.backlash_prose: Piercing bone-chime resonance rattles behind your jaw.

variants.label: Break the Marrow-Dust Threshold
variants.clue_text: Fine pale bone-dust outlines the curtain base like frost.
variants.success_prose: You sweep clean iron filings across the seam, dampening the hall echo.
variants.backlash_prose: Fine dust swells upward into your nostrils, heavy with ancient dry grit.

variants.label: Clamp the Trembling Hazard Curtain
variants.clue_text: Heavy vinyl ripples inward and outward like lung tissue.
variants.success_prose: You lash the curtain weights down to floor bollards.
variants.backlash_prose: A dry snapping slap leaves bruises along your forearm.

variants.label: Silence the Swinging Ribcage
variants.clue_text: Each gentle pendulum swing of the great skeleton rings every skull in the hall.
variants.success_prose: You lash a lead weight to the sternum cable, stopping its swing cold.
variants.backlash_prose: Heavy fossil claws swing down inches past your temple.

variants.label: Floodlight the Detaching Raptor Shadows
variants.clue_text: Silhouettes prowl across marble floors even with skeletons bolted fast.
variants.success_prose: You angle two halogen worklamps upward into the ribcages, killing every false shadow.
variants.backlash_prose: Sharp acoustic snaps strike like stone splinters against your ankles.

variants.label: Strike the Scratched Nameplates
variants.clue_text: Victims scratched phonetic syllables onto brass taxonomy plaques.
variants.success_prose: You trace and invert the resonant phrase, un-keying the hall echo.
variants.backlash_prose: A sour dry ring scrambles your thoughts mid-sentence.

variants.label: Invert the Parabolic Acoustic Dish
variants.clue_text: A brass dish collects faint floor tremors and beams them upward into the skulls.
variants.success_prose: You rotate the acoustic dish downward into the solid pitch, muffling the wing.
variants.backlash_prose: A condensed tremor blasts chest-first from the brass bell.

variants.label: Salt the Pitch-Sunk Rib Ring
variants.clue_text: Half-submerged ribs thrum in the solid black pool like plucked bass strings.
variants.success_prose: You pour dampening mineral salt across the rib ring until vibrations fade.
variants.backlash_prose: Cold static tremor locks your teeth together painfully.

variants.label: Shatter the Curator's Calibration Horn
variants.clue_text: The cracked brass tube continues piping sub-bass long after the tar hardened.
variants.success_prose: You crack the horn seam cleanly, collapsing the standing wave.
variants.backlash_prose: Eardrum-popping pressure knocks equilibrium crooked.

boss_profile.folklore_motif_hint: Lithic sound-memory trapped in prehistoric marrow.
boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: A final dry rattle settles along the wire mounts; museum air drops heavy and silent.

loc_weeping_crypt.name: The Weeping Bell-Tower Crypt
loc_weeping_crypt.base_horror_sensory: Freezing brine condenses along every bone wall beneath Uptown's stones, soaking clothing to the marrow. Hollow sobbing bubbles out of flooded niches while silent ripples spread across mirror-black standing water with nobody wading there.
loc_weeping_crypt.gore_horror_sensory: Closer along the femur shelves, half the skulls weep dark bloody serum from cracked orbital sockets; tiny silver calcifications crystallize directly along wet knuckles wherever salt water clings too long.
loc_weeping_crypt.pacified_sensory: Salty grief-tears dry to harmless white mineral frost; the cracked bell hangs quiet over clear cold groundwater.
loc_weeping_crypt.crowd_stillness_prose: Only cold stone condensation and faint muffled drips beneath iron street grates hint at the crypt below.

domain_rule.hazard_cue: Bone-deep brine saturates gear and stiffens joints with rapid mineral chill.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Hallowed ossuary silence steadies aqueous channeling and grief containment.

variants.backlash_prose: Freezing brine splashes over your cuffs, locking fingers stiff.

variants.backlash_prose: Sudden limestone chill shoots pain straight up your ankles.

variants.label: Recover the Intact Litany Page

variants.success_prose: You extract the mourning litany intact to steady the descent.
variants.backlash_prose: Cold water surges up from the lower steps, soaking boots instantly.

variants.label: Silence the Clinking Brass Thimbles
variants.clue_text: Loose thimbles vibrate inside empty eye sockets to form a weeping rhythm.
variants.success_prose: You wedge tallow wax across the lead niche, halting the chime.
variants.backlash_prose: A cold ripple erupts ankle-deep across the floor, numbing calves.

variants.label: Break the Lime-Welded Pews
variants.clue_text: Calcified stone ribs dam the flooded floor drain toward the bell well.
variants.success_prose: You crack the lime ridge open so standing black water drops away.
variants.backlash_prose: Sharp calcified bone splinters nick your gauntlets as water surges.

variants.label: Scatter the Unreflecting Pool
variants.clue_text: Hands reach upward just beneath the opaque surface without breaking ripple tension.
variants.success_prose: You cast consecrated ash across the flooded aisle until reflections return.
variants.backlash_prose: Freezing mist rises into your chest like inhaled water.

variants.label: Unbind the Inverted Bell Clapper
variants.clue_text: Submerged silently in brine, the inverted iron bell trembles ready to toll.
variants.success_prose: You haul the clapper loose from its chain, silencing the crypt's grief chime.
variants.backlash_prose: A deafening underwater boom slams pressure straight through your ribs.

variants.label: Sever the Spine-Knotted Bell Rope
variants.clue_text: Sodden rope fibers knot themselves tightly around bone fragments hanging over the basin.
variants.success_prose: You slice the knotted hemp clean above water level.
variants.backlash_prose: The whipping rope coils wetly around your forearm, stinging like salt whip.

variants.label: Close the Bubbling Reliquary Tomb
variants.clue_text: Mourning vapor boils steadily from a cracked slate sarcophagus beneath the bell.
variants.success_prose: You slide the heavy slab home and set iron wedges cleanly.
variants.backlash_prose: Icy salt tears burn your cheeks as the tomb groans shut.

boss_profile.folklore_motif_hint: Locked medieval plague ossuary drowned under Uptown drainage.
boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: The upside-down bell settles dead still; the dripping ossuary falls dryly hushed.

loc_bz_carnivorous_dome.name: Quarantined Biome 4 Carnivorous Flora Jungle
loc_bz_carnivorous_dome.base_horror_sensory: Humid carrion-sweet jungle heat fogs every lens. Somewhere inside the choked palm ferns, flowers mimic the exact cadence of missing park botanists calling for help—while thorny pitcher tendrils drip slow purple digestive resin onto damp walkways.
loc_bz_carnivorous_dome.gore_horror_sensory: Half-dissolved yellow Tyvek suits hang caught inside the corpse-flower's translucent bladder sacks, pale chest-cavities still moving weakly as crimson rootlets tap directly into spinal fluid.
loc_bz_carnivorous_dome.pacified_sensory: Digestive vents dry up and voice-mimic buds curl politely shut; dense emerald foliage releases clean, revitalizing chlorophyll warmth across the glass dome.
loc_bz_carnivorous_dome.crowd_stillness_prose: Steamed over with algae from within, Dome 4's safety doors stay bolted shut away from paying zoo families.

domain_rule.name: Hallucinogenic Spore-Pollen
domain_rule.hazard_cue: Sweet hallucinogenic pollen blisters skin, saps focus, and mimics friendly companion voices to spoil timing.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Tamed exotic photosynthesis gently knits minor wounds and empowers bio resonance.

variants.label: Purge the Cracked Hazmat Airlock
variants.clue_text: Thick green tendrils choke the emergency decon nozzle above the airlock.
variants.success_prose: You slice away the root collar and open the dry nitrogen mist line.
variants.backlash_prose: Thorned vines lash back across your forearm, stinging with venom.

variants.label: Stop the Mimic Playback Reel
variants.clue_text: Spotted seed-pods vibrate directly beside the dead botanist's spinning recorder.
variants.success_prose: You eject the warped cassette, breaking the floral mimic cue.
variants.backlash_prose: A phantom friend's scream bursts behind your ear, scrambling composure.

variants.label: Clamp the Cracked Entry Louver
variants.clue_text: Pollen gusts spill through splintered glass louvers beside the threshold.
variants.success_prose: You wedge steel shutters tightly over the cracked intake.
variants.backlash_prose: Toxic spore clouds blow straight across your face shield.

variants.label: Trim the Voice-Mimic Pod Cluster
variants.clue_text: Three bulbous pods repeat familiar warnings in three distinct human voices.
variants.success_prose: You sever all three vocal bladders cleanly at the stem before spores release.
variants.backlash_prose: Hallucinogenic pollen pops across your vest, burning throat and eyes.

variants.label: Sear the Pollen-Shedding Brambles
variants.clue_text: Yellow pollen drifts like living fireflies through waist-high brambles.
variants.success_prose: Focused heat curls the pollen fronds black without torching the dome.
variants.backlash_prose: Thorny whip-vines snap across your calf as flames flare.

variants.label: Dump Herbicidal Neutralizer Tank
variants.clue_text: Half-crushed spray canisters lie beside the ruined botanical desk.
variants.success_prose: You rig the pressure nozzle over the mimic grove, wilting its tendrils.
variants.backlash_prose: Acidic sap splatters across your cuffs as tubes rupture.

variants.label: Pierce the Corpse-Flower Taproot
variants.clue_text: At the jungle heart, a car-sized mottled bloom opens like a ribcage breathing hot vapor.
variants.success_prose: You drive an anchor spike cleanly down through its pale heart-stem.
variants.backlash_prose: Digestive acid mist erupts across your armor in a blinding cloud.

variants.label: Seal the Carrion Nectar Basin
variants.clue_text: Translucent sacs swell inside the central crater with dark crimson sap.
variants.success_prose: You sear the central ovary ring shut, ending its brood cycle.
variants.backlash_prose: Thorn-whips slam out from the calyx, tearing cleanly across shoulders.

variants.label: Choke the Taproot Conduit
variants.clue_text: Root-cables draw nutrients up through cracked concrete cistern pipes.
variants.success_prose: You pack rock salt and ash directly into the taproot fissure.
variants.backlash_prose: The great flower shudders violently, knocking balance underfoot.

boss_profile.folklore_motif_hint: Bio-mimicry jungle specimen fed on missing botanical night-shift interns.
boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: The giant bloom folds quietly closed, breathing only cool wet moss.

loc_bz_tank_nine.name: Sub-Level Tank 9 Abyssal Leviathan Anomaly
loc_bz_tank_nine.base_horror_sensory: Three floors beneath the zoo lies a reinforced viewing gallery staring into water too dark and vast to fit inside any city basement. Deep sonar thuds shake fillings loose in your teeth, and an impossible pale pupil occasionally rolls close to the groaning acrylic wall.
loc_bz_tank_nine.gore_horror_sensory: Fleshy pale barnacle-growths and bruised human-shaped impressions bump gently along the inner glass face from the abyssal side, rolling limp past floodlight cones before vanishing into crushing gloom.
loc_bz_tank_nine.pacified_sensory: Whatever slumbers beyond the acrylic retreats down unseen fathoms; the sub-level chamber keeps an unshakable deep-water coolness that steels lungs and endurance.
loc_bz_tank_nine.crowd_stillness_prose: Heavy floodgates seal off Sub-Level 9 beneath the aquarium gift shop; even veteran keepers refuse to clean its pumps.

domain_rule.hazard_cue: Abyssal barotrauma slams eardrums while frigid condensation soaks limbs and slows heavy gear.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Stabilized deep-trench calm tempers endurance and abyssal water channeling.

variants.backlash_prose: Constructive interference shakes iron dust off ceiling trusses onto your head.

variants.clue_text: Salt frost spells out shifting geometric runes across cold viewing glass.
variants.success_prose: You sever the central geometric link before another tidal surge hits.
variants.backlash_prose: Icy salt chill locks calves and lungs for breathless seconds.

boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: The huge pale shadow glides downward into black water until only murky tank glass remains.

loc_crimson_auction_house.name: The Crimson Masquerade Auction House
loc_crimson_auction_house.base_horror_sensory: Tallow candles burn without melting beneath Sovereign Hills, filling gilded air with copper, cinnamon, and roasted bone. Masked patrons sit stone-still in velvet boxes while every struck gavel note makes your pulse itch to bid away pieces of yourself.
loc_crimson_auction_house.gore_horror_sensory: Behind crimson velvet hangs fresh stitched skin stretched over mahogany wainscoting; the holding crates thud rhythmically with mutilated prisoners whose tongues were auctioned in numbered velvet envelopes.
loc_crimson_auction_house.pacified_sensory: The suffocating brimstone candle-smoke clears into austere gilded stillness; only poised theatrical gravity remains clinging to the empty crimson tiers.
loc_crimson_auction_house.crowd_stillness_prose: Behind sealed iron cellar doors beneath Ultra-Rich mansions, muffled velvet echoes go answered by no legitimate auctioneer.

loc_glass_mirage_estate.name: The Glass Mirage Estate Anomaly
loc_glass_mirage_estate.base_horror_sensory: A pale mid-crash chandelier hangs three feet above the ballroom floor, frozen in crystalline suspension since 11:50. Ice-white light bends time into ten-minute loops where silver champagne spills upward and doppelgänger silhouettes waltz three beats behind your own footsteps.
loc_glass_mirage_estate.gore_horror_sensory: Inside the frosted conservatory, dozens of pale manicured hands jut cleanly out through frozen orchid ice—guests trapped mid-flight when time crystallized around the shattered dome panes.
loc_glass_mirage_estate.pacified_sensory: With a soft musical sigh, the suspended chandelier touches harmless velvet dust; cool winter diamond-light hovers serenely through unbroken glass.
loc_glass_mirage_estate.crowd_stillness_prose: Through wrought-iron estate gates, moonlight refracts strangely off dead winter glass where nobody comes or goes.

domain_rule.hazard_cue: Time refracts in jagged ten-minute shards, chilling focus and snapping disoriented travelers back down mirrored corridors.
domain_rule.ambient_summary: Refracted prism stillness sharpens icy evasion and mirror timing.

variants.backlash_prose: Cold mist sweeps upward out of cracked marble slabs.

variants.success_prose: Steady heat releases the final ice knot cleanly to mist.
variants.backlash_prose: Shattering glass needles drop inward in freezing hail.

boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: The floating glass splinters settle softly into fine frost on marble tiles.

loc_liminal_residential.name: Tenement Block 4 & Room 404 Anomaly
loc_liminal_residential.base_horror_sensory: Yellow-brown hallway carpet smells faintly of wet radiator steam and burnt toast, yet no tenant lives past Floor 2. Door numbers climb backward between landings while a static-gray TV in Room 404 monitors your own shoulders from a camera bolted nowhere in the ceiling.
loc_liminal_residential.gore_horror_sensory: Inside the fire-hose box and hallway vents coil dried black veins resembling umbilical cords; beneath Room 404's wallpaper pulses soft, damp plaster warm to a lingering knuckle.
loc_liminal_residential.pacified_sensory: Mustard hallways flatten back into ordinary cramped concrete; even inside Room 404, only quiet threshold intuition lingers in stale radiator warmth.
loc_liminal_residential.crowd_stillness_prose: Tenement Block 4 sits black-windowed beside working streetlamps; neighbors hurry past without glancing up toward Floor 4.

variants.label: Clear the Blank 404 Mailboxes

variants.label: Cut the Warm 404 Buzzer
variants.clue_text: The 404 buzzer vibrates warmly as if someone upstairs leans endlessly on the key.
variants.success_prose: You disconnect the copper loop behind the rusted faceplate.
variants.backlash_prose: Static jolts through your fingers, dizzying direction.

variants.label: Trace the Unmoving Shoe Prints
variants.clue_text: Damp muddy footprints end midway toward nowhere across the vestibule.

variants.backlash_prose: Outside street noise vanishes suddenly, leaving ringing silence.

variants.label: Rip Open the Repeating Wallpaper

variants.backlash_prose: Warm damp plaster shudders beneath your fingers like cold skin.

variants.label: Sever the Coiled Wire Inside Hose Box

variants.backlash_prose: A whip-crack shudder snaps across your shin.

variants.label: Block the Burnt-Toast Hall Vent

variants.backlash_prose: Stale dizzying fumes choke throat and focus.

variants.label: Smash the Room 404 Monitor TV
variants.clue_text: The tube screen displays the exact angle behind your neck—and a doorway opening behind you.
variants.success_prose: You cave the phosphor tube in with one clean blow before anything steps out.
variants.backlash_prose: Imploding static hurls you backwards against the plastic dining chair.

variants.label: Seal the Breathing Closet Door
variants.clue_text: Behind a thin hollow-core door, rhythmic lungs draw deeper breath every second.
variants.success_prose: You drive an iron wedge beneath the jamb and draw a threshold sigil.
variants.backlash_prose: A violent thud rattles the door frame, rattling your nerves.

variants.label: Stop the Sideways Wall Clock

variants.success_prose: You pull the clock off the nail and snap its quartz battery casing.
variants.backlash_prose: Static rings loud in both ears before quiet falls.

boss_profile.folklore_motif_hint: Demolished apartment room that never accepted erasure from municipal ledgers.
boss_profile.ritual_seal_prose: Outside traffic rumble filters cleanly back up through the hallway vents.

loc_flesh_sewer_junction.name: The Flesh-Stitched Sewer Nest
loc_flesh_sewer_junction.base_horror_sensory: Street ladders drop straight out of rainwater concrete into warm, humid esophagus walls that flex rhythmically every four seconds. Floodwater runs warm as fresh blood over slippery pink fascia, while soft rhythmic peristalsis threatens to crush travelers between living sewer ribs.
loc_flesh_sewer_junction.gore_horror_sensory: Human clavicles and half-melted emergency worker helmets jut half-absorbed out of swollen gum-pink culvert walls—some helmets still holding slack pale jawbones clenched around cracked respirator tubes.
loc_flesh_sewer_junction.pacified_sensory: The fleshy ribs calcify into brittle, dry coral-stone that no longer squeezes shut; bio-reactive stillness lingers weakly in warm humid pipework.
loc_flesh_sewer_junction.crowd_stillness_prose: Welded manhole covers tremble gently along Lower Ward gutters; sewer crews refuse to approach within three city blocks.

domain_rule.ambient_summary: Calcified somatic stillness sharpens bio-alchemy and toxin resistance.

variants.backlash_prose: A tidal wash of scorching acid blood hurls you against tunnel stone.

variants.label: Break the Hazmat Ossuary Anchor

variants.success_prose: You pry loose the central brass respirator unit and drop consecrated salt.

loc_subterranean_bunker.name: Subterranean Cold-War Bunker
loc_subterranean_bunker.base_horror_sensory: Behind three-foot blast steel, a dead Cold-War station broadcasts four-digit voices on frequencies that penetrate bone marrow. Phone receivers go dead at the threshold while vacuum tubes hiss coded countdowns through skulls glued over ancient leather headphones.
loc_subterranean_bunker.gore_horror_sensory: Operators sit stiffly upright at brass teletypes—fingertips ground down to pale knuckles from typing endless cipher sheets onto leather and skin long after the last ribbon ink ran dry decades ago.
loc_subterranean_bunker.pacified_sensory: Vacuum tubes cool down in sharp little clicks; Faraday shielding returns clean mental clarity while city phone bands remain calm.
loc_subterranean_bunker.crowd_stillness_prose: Rust streaks down reinforced airlock hatches beneath Industrial District factories; no utility team traces wires past Bulkhead 1.

loc_reactor_silo_7.name: Quarantined Reactor Silo 7 Anomaly
loc_reactor_silo_7.base_horror_sensory: Down Silo 7's shaft, physics contradicts heat itself: liquid nitrogen-cold burns skin like blistering grease while jagged graphite needles float beside cobalt Cerenkov blue shadows. Breath freezes straight into sharp metallic frost inside your collar.
loc_reactor_silo_7.gore_horror_sensory: Kneeling coolant-suit figures near the furnace rim didn't simply freeze—vitrified ribcages glow faint cobalt beneath translucent frost-blistered skin, dripping melted marrow-ice that scorches concrete beneath their boots.
loc_reactor_silo_7.pacified_sensory: Blue Cerenkov glare retreats safely below silent boron water; paradoxical frost-radiation softens into crisp cryo-thermal control.
loc_reactor_silo_7.crowd_stillness_prose: Thick blast lead plugs every Silo 7 road junction; warning sirens here rusted dead years before anyone called containment.

loc_ghost_freighter.name: The Ghost Container Freighter
loc_ghost_freighter.base_horror_sensory: Moored silently off Deepwater Pier sits a freighter whose wheelhouse glass shows black mid-ocean swells instead of city docks. Cold salt bilge-fog seeps into lungs until breathing tastes like brackish lung-water, and deck compasses spin maniacally without finding north.
loc_ghost_freighter.gore_horror_sensory: Below the waterline, damp cargo tarps conceal stacked crates packed full of soaked naval pea-coats—empty chests swelling gently in cold black brine while bleached fingernails scratch steadily along the inside of locked steel lids.
loc_ghost_freighter.pacified_sensory: Harbor lights come cleanly back through cleared bridge glass; the old freighter rides flat on calm dock swells with reassuringly steady footing.
loc_ghost_freighter.crowd_stillness_prose: Moored behind steel harbour booms, the silent rust hull rides higher than empty ballast laws allow.

loc_abyssal_drydock.name: The Abyssal Drydock Trench Anomaly
loc_abyssal_drydock.base_horror_sensory: Once drained for ship repairs, Drydock 4 now yawns impossibly deep beneath harbor concrete—floodlights lose their beams before touching bottom. Down on the slick keel steps, gravity doubles down on chest walls as unseen pressure squeezes every lungful of damp air.
loc_abyssal_drydock.gore_horror_sensory: Along the crushed diving-bell catwalk, three weighted canvas salvage suits hang inverted on dredge hooks; pale swollen forearms droop from torn wrist cuffs, skin translucent enough to trace black trench-silt pumped directly through veins.
loc_abyssal_drydock.pacified_sensory: Crushing benthic weight eases off shoulders like shedding lead plates; only deep oceanic calm lingers along the drained concrete sump.
loc_abyssal_drydock.crowd_stillness_prose: Harbor searchlights swing nervously past Drydock 4; crane operators swear the concrete trough runs deeper at midnight than any pier chart shows.

loc_theme_park.name: Theme Park & Amusement Resort
loc_theme_park.daytime_cordon_sensory: By bright coastal daylight, families queue past popcorn stalls under cheerful calliope speakers—yet the Hall of Mirrors and 10-PM Carousel remain cordoned behind velvet rope and Bureau safety tape. Through tinted glass glint faint fiberglass mascot teeth and a motionless brass calliope that hums faintly under noon sun.
loc_theme_park.base_horror_sensory: The moment 10:00 PM chimes clear the gates, carnival neon bleeds bruised violet through coastal fog. Hollow-eyed fiberglass mascot husks stalk wet midway puddles with heavy unnatural joints; unpowered coaster cars rattle fifty feet overhead packed tight with rigid weeping silhouettes; midway cotton-candy drums spin damp pale sinew-threads, and inside the Hall of Mirrors your reflection stops blinking first.
loc_theme_park.gore_horror_sensory: Worn fiberglass mascot seams split wetly open along necklines to expose stitched human jawbones whispering jingles; carousel poles gleam slick with warm arterial axle-grease dripping onto chipped wooden teeth, while stray children's raincoats puddle dark crimson beneath empty bumper-car bays.
loc_theme_park.witching_peak_sensory: WITCHING PEAK (00:00–03:00): Midnight coastal fog turns pitch-black past the midway bulbs. Every ride runs backward at once—the Giant Ferris Wheel groans in reverse while tall crowned carnival anomalies step straight out from between the mirror frames.
loc_theme_park.crowd_stillness_prose: All daytime park-goers and ride operators have vanished behind emergency shutters; only flickering midway bulbs, backward-looping calliope notes, and scraping fiberglass steps echo across coastal mist.
